pages.text: The reactor feeds on liquid fuel: fill a Fuel Cell (10,000 mb / 10 L) with the Fuel Canner and place it in the controller's fuel slots. Fuel drains at a constant rate of 1 mb every 2.5 seconds.$(br2)$(bold)Utilization & per-slot output (optimal temperature):$()$(li)World Base Fuel: 3, 450k/t (heat 120)$(li)Nether Compound Fuel: 4, 600k/t (heat 240)$(li)End Mixture Fuel: 4, 600k/t (heat 250)$(li)Advanced Mixture Fuel: 5, 750k/t (heat 240)$(li)Pure Fuel: 8, 1.2M/t (heat 384)$(li)Dragon Fuel: 7, 1.05M/t (heat 252)$(li)Ultimate Mixture Fuel: 14, 2.1M/t (heat 448)$(br2)Each rod's heat value feeds the raw temperature (base 300℃ + sum of heat values); 10 rods burning Ultimate Mixture yield roughly 21M/t total.

$(bold)Acquiring fuel:$()$(li)Energy Liquefier: Nether Star → Nether Pure Energy; Wither Rose → Nether Compound Energy (400 mb); End Mixture → End Mixture Fuel (500 mb); World Base Fuel item → World Base Fuel (100 mb); Dragon Mixture → Dragon Fuel (500 mb; some recipes need Life Essence Solids)$(li)Energy Processor: refines pure/compound energy into Pure Fuel and Nether Compound Fuel$(li)Fuel Mixer: End Mixture 1000 mb + Nether Compound 1000 mb → Advanced Mixture 1500 mb; Dragon Fuel 50 mb + Pure 50 mb → Ultimate Mixture 50 mb$(br2)All three mixture ingredients (End Mixture, Dragon Mixture, World Base Fuel item) are crafted at a crafting table.
